children: LG Electronics has joined Nvidia's official partner program for AI data center cooling solutions and was named a preferred partner in the power and cooling category. According to ChainCatcher, LG said it aims to expand in the hyperscale data center and colocation markets, with a particular focus on North America, where more than 60% of global new data center capacity demand is concentrated.

title: LG Electronics Joins Nvidia AI Data Center Cooling Partner Program
